description: Test suite for session access and visibility functions, using Vitest for unit testing different session visibility and agent-to-agent policies in a software project related to OpenClaw.

methods.name: resolveSessionToolsVisibility
methods.description: Determines the visibility setting for session tools based on configuration, returning values like 'tree' or 'all'.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveSessionToolsVisibility
methods.description: Resolves the effective session tools visibility, considering sandboxing and configuration.

methods.name: resolveSandboxSessionToolsVisibility
methods.description: Provides default sandbox session tools visibility, typically 'spawned'.

methods.name: resolveSandboxedSessionToolContext
methods.description: Creates context for sandboxed session tools, indicating restrictions and requester keys.

methods.name: createAgentToAgentPolicy
methods.description: Creates a policy object to control cross-agent messaging permissions.

methods.name: createSessionVisibilityGuard
methods.description: Creates a guard object to enforce session visibility constraints based on configuration and policies.

ctags.name: policy
ctags.pattern: /^    const policy = createAgentToAgentPolicy({} as unknown as OpenClawConfig);$/
